title: Starter: BC547 transistor switch driving an LED
finish: Parts placed. Emitter to ground, LED and 330 ohm from +5 V to the collector, 1 kilo-ohm from your control wire to the base. Touch the control wire to +5 V and the LED lights.

steps.instruction: Place the breadboard flat in front of the camera.
Place the BC547 transistor on the left half, flat face toward you.

expect.label: transistor
expect.zone_hint: Move the transistor to the left half of the board.

steps.tip: BC547 with the flat face toward you and legs down: collector, base, emitter from left to right.

steps.instruction: Place the 1 kilo-ohm base resistor (brown, black, red) right next to the transistor.
steps.tip: It goes between your control signal and the middle leg (base).

steps.instruction: Place the LED (with its 330 ohm resistor) on the right side as the load.
steps.tip: LED long leg toward +5 V; the resistor and LED together go from +5 V to the collector.
